Operations Manager (Oil Waste Management) Job at Westfield Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Westfield Consulting Limited - Our client in the Oil & Gas space, is recruiting qualified and passionate candidate to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operations Manager (Oil Waste Management)
Job Location: Warri, Koko, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	To oversee and manage the operational activities of the company’s oil waste management division, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations, optimizing resource utilization, and driving efficiency in petroleum, industrial, medical, and domestic waste management services.
	The role ensures smooth coordination across environmental consultancy, pollution control, haulage, and marine services.


Key Responsibilities


	Operational Oversight: Manage day-to-day operations of oil waste management projects, ensuring efficiency, safety, and compliance with industry standards.
	Regulatory Compliance: Ensure adherence to Nigerian environmental laws, DPR (Department of Petroleum Resources) guidelines, and international best practices.
	Team Leadership: Supervise and mentor operational staff, drivers, engineers, and marine crew to achieve performance targets.
	Project Management: Plan, execute, and monitor waste management projects, including petroleum product recovery, industrial waste disposal, and medical/domestic waste treatment.
	Environmental Consultancy: Provide technical input on pollution control strategies, environmental impact assessments, and sustainability initiatives.
	Logistics & Haulage: Oversee haulage operations, ensuring timely and safe transportation of waste and petroleum products.
	Marine Services: Coordinate marine waste management operations, including offshore waste collection and spill response.
	Client Relationship Management: Maintain strong relationships with oil & gas clients, government agencies, and stakeholders.
	Financial Management: Develop budgets, monitor expenditure, and ensure cost-effective operations.


Key Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Environmental Sciences, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or related field.
	Minimum of 10-12 years of experience in oil & gas operations, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
	Strong knowledge of pollution control, waste treatment technologies, and marine operations
	Proven leadership and project management skills
	Master’s degree or professional certifications (e.g., NEBOSH, ISO 14001) is an added advantage


Competencies:


	Strategic Planning and execution
	Strong leadership and people management skills
	Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management abilities
	Knowledge of environmental compliance and pollution control
	Analytical and problem-solving skills
	Proficiency in logistics software and ERP systems.


Salary


	N1,200,000  – N1,500,000 per month (Net Salary)
	However, the salary can be negotiated upward depending on the candidate’s experience)


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their current CV to: [email protected] cc [email protected] using the Job Position you are applying for as title of the email

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
